samples.xml_description:
<module id="fixed_point_adder">
    <description>A parameterized fixed-point adder for performing addition/subtraction operations based on the signs of two inputs.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">The first input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">The second input operand.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">The output result of the operation.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="Q">Number of fractional bits.</parameter>
        <parameter id="N">Total number of bits (including integer and fractional parts).</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="res" width_description="[N-1:0]">Register to store the result of the operation.</register>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Internal variables
        reg [N-1:0] abs_a;
        reg [N-1:0] abs_b;
        reg [N-1:0] temp_result;
        reg [N-1:0] final_result;
        
        // Calculate the absolute values of a and b
        if(a[N-1] == b[N-1]) begin
            abs_a = a + ~{N{a[N-1]}} + 1;
            abs_b = b + ~{N{b[N-1]}} + 1;
            
            // Add the absolute values of a and b
            temp_result = abs_a + abs_b;
            
            // Set the result's sign bit to match the sign bits of a and b
            final_result = {temp_result[N-2], temp_result[N-2:N-1]};
        end else begin
            // Determine which operand has a larger absolute value
            if(a > b) begin
                abs_a = a + ~{N{a[N-1]}} + 1;
                abs_b = b + ~{N{b[N-1]}} + 1;
                
                // Subtract the smaller absolute value from the larger one
                temp_result = abs_a - abs_b;
                
                // Set the result's sign bit to indicate positive result
                final_result = {1'b0, temp_result[N-2:0]};
            end else begin
                abs_a = a + ~{N{a[N-1]}} + 1;
                abs_b = b + ~{N{b[N-1]}} + 1;
                
                // Subtract the smaller absolute value from the larger one
                temp_result = abs_b - abs_a;
                
                // Check if the result is zero
                if(temp_result == 0) begin
                    // Result is zero, set the sign bit accordingly
                    final_result = {1'b0, {N-1{1'b0}}};
                end else begin
                    // Result is not zero, set the sign bit to indicate negative result
                    final_result = {1'b1, temp_result[N-2:0]};
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assign the final result to the output port 'c'
        c <= final_result;
    </implementation>
</module>
